caption: A bucket of water is emptied over a concrete sidewalk, and the water spreads out in a thin sheet and runs toward the lower side.

sa.check: A bucket of water is emptied over a concrete sidewalk.
The water spreads out in a thin sheet.
It runs toward the lower side.
The emptying comes first and the spread and run follow.

pc.expect: The sheet spreads outward from where it lands, thin, leaving the concrete wet and dark.
pc.fail: The water stays in a heap; or it holds the bucket's shape; or it beads into balls.

pc.expect: It flows downhill toward the lower side and pools there.
pc.fail: It runs uphill; or spreads evenly on a plainly sloped surface; or rises.

pc.expect: The wet patch only grows and darkens.
pc.fail: It shrinks back; or the concrete dries instantly; or the wet patch appears before the water.

pc.expect: The bucket empties by being tipped, and the water moves only by flowing.
pc.fail: Water leaps from an upright bucket; or the sheet stops dead mid-slope; or water moves back into the bucket.

pc.expect: One bucket, and water comes only from it.
pc.fail: Water appears where none was poured; or the bucket duplicates; or water passes through the bucket.

pc.expect: The bucket and the sidewalk stay the same.
pc.fail: The bucket changes colour; or the sidewalk's slabs shift; or the surroundings rearrange.
